text.en: Section 1 of the Autoriti Monetari Brunei Darussalam Order, 2010, in this to as the principal Order, is amended - fa} in subsection {1), by deleting "Autoriti Monetari Brunei by substituting "Brunei Darussalam Central Bank" fbi {2), by deleting "Autoriti Monetari Brunei to act as the central bank of Brunei Darussalam," from the and third lines and by substituting ""Brunei Darussalam Central of section 2 3-Section 2 of the principal Order is amended - fa} in the definition of ""Authority"", by deleting ""Autoriti Monetari Brunei Darussalam" and by substituting '"Brunei Darussalam Central Bank" fbi in the definition of '"Minister", by inserting '"and Economy'" immediately after '"Finance"_ of section 3
Section 3 of the principal Order is amended, in subsection {1). by deleting known as the Autoriti Monetari Brunei Darussalam'" and by ""the Brunei Darussalam Central Bank" therefor. of section 56

Section 56 of the principal Order is amended, in subsection (lOj, by deleting "Autoriti Monetari Brunei Darussalam"' from the last two lines and by substituting '"Brunei Darussalam Central Bank" therefor. and transitional provisions

111 Any right, benefit, privilege, obligation or liability acquired, accrued or or any act or thing done or required to be done, shall not be affected by this Order and shall continue to remain valid and have effect as if this Order had not been enacted. (21 This Order shall not affect any inquiry, investigation or proceedings or pending before the commencement of this Order and every such inquiry, investigation or proceedings may be continued and dealt with as if this had not been enacted. (3J In so far as it is necessary for preserving the effect of any written law or document, any reference in such written law or document to the Autoriti Monetari Brunei Darussalam shall, as from the commencement of this Order, be construed as a reference to the Brunei Darussalam Central Bank. Made this 15th. day of Zulkaedah, 1442 Hijriah corresponding to the 26th. day of June, 2021.

HIS MAJESTY THE SULTAN AND YANG DJ.PERTUAN, DARUSSALAM.
